note: Section 2 (cursed technique & tools) of the Aoi Todo cluster. Rosters staged in _jjk_page_aoi_todo.decl2.yaml.

retired.question: Every technique or ability of Aoi Todo
retired.reason: Not declared as a roster. The Abilities and Powers section enumerates prose lead-ins (Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant, Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Speed, Great Tactical Intellect, Cursed Energy Manipulation, Cursed Energy Reinforcement) alongside the techniques and tools, so 'every technique or ability' is not the closed, page-stated set the Cursed Technique section names. Declared the closed Cursed Technique set instead (Every named cursed technique of Aoi Todo) and answered the abilities per-item via this section's qa questions.

retired.question: Every tool or object Aoi Todo carries
retired.reason: Not declared as a mixed set. The Equipment section splits Cursed Tools (Playful Cloud) from Non-Cursed Tools (Vibraslap); only the closed cursed-tool set is declared (Every cursed tool Aoi Todo carries, staged in _jjk_page_aoi_todo.decl2.yaml), and the vibraslap is a non-cursed tool, so a combined cursed + non-cursed enumeration is left to discovery and answered per-tool via the qa questions.

questions.question: What does Aoi Todo's innate cursed technique do?
questions.subject: Aoi Todo

answer.item: Todo's innate technique allows him to switch the positions of anything with cursed energy within his range with a clap of his hands

questions.note: Aoi Todo, Cursed Technique > Innate Technique (Boogie Woogie).

questions.question: Besides switching with another person, what else can Aoi switch with Boogie Woogie?
